Following an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Sagma|victory]] in the [[Sagma system/Legends|Sagma system]], an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bannidge Holt]] '''besieged''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. The Imperial force was composed of [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruisers]]&mdash;originally intended for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|government]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] region&mdash;and a few [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] housing [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. The siege was part of the [[Listehol Campaign]], an Imperial strike at [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] of the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] to remove [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild|Zygerrian]] and [[Tervig]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], who were backed up by [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from that area. The interdiction ended when the native [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] negotiated peace with am [[Unidentified Imperial Advisor (Zygerria)|Imperial Advisor]] who arrived with [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] reinforcements. The siege was followed by a [[Raids on Tervissis|set of raids]] conducted by the Imperials against the planet [[Tervissis]].<ref name="War" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siege was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="War" />
